chapter_seo_title: Han Li Sets a Secret Formation & Faces Chen Qiaoqian — Chapter 319
chapter_meta_description: Han Li infiltrates the imperial palace at night to set up a Reversed Five Elements Formation as a hidden trump card. The next day, Chen Qiaoqian confronts him about their shared past.
og_title: Han Li’s Midnight Array & a Past Resurfacing
og_description: A quiet chapter of preparation and unresolved history—Han Li plants a formation in the palace while Chen Qiaoqian digs into old secrets.
twitter_title: Han Li Plants a Secret Formation
twitter_description: Night infiltration, a hidden array, and an ice queen’s probing questions—Han Li’s past catches up with him.

lore_anchors.definition: A portable defensive array that disrupts the normal Five Elements flow, creating illusions and concealment; a powerful trump card for setting ambushes or protecting a position.
A basic spell that seals sound within a defined area, used for covert activities or private conversations.
A speed-focused flying artifact refined from Ink Flood Dragon fin and tail; extremely fast but lacks defensive capabilities.
The colloquial name for the quadrennial forced-entry mission into a sealed forbidden land, characterized by extreme inter-sect violence and low survival rates.

surfaces: Playing the Pig to Eat the Tiger
lore_anchors.definition: A classic Chinese idiom describing someone who feigns weakness to deceive opponents before striking decisively.
The isolated, abandoned palace sector where the Black Fiend Cult Leader is in seclusion; heavily guarded but emblematic of neglect elsewhere.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li avoid acknowledging he saved Chen Qiaoqian?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He believes her past intimacy with Senior Brother Lu makes her unsuitable as a partner, but admitting the rescue would entangle him emotionally and logistically; he prefers to keep the debt unresolved.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the purpose of the Reversed Five Elements Formation in this chapter?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Han Li plants it as a life-saving fallback in case the battle against the Black Fiend Cult turns unfavorable; it gives him a fortified position he can retreat to.
